title: Spyglass is Here!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making its powerful capabilities accessible to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Gain complete control over your content with new powerful features that let you easily add, remove, download, and customize how your images and files appear in the editor.

title: Introducing Our Product Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to launch our new public roadmap, offering you complete transparency into our latest features and exciting future developments.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger and easier to click, with a fresh new look and drag-and-drop functionality to streamline your workflow.

title: Elevated Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience smoother teamwork and heightened awareness with our latest enhancements designed to make collaborating with others more intuitive and enjoyable than ever before.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and work together on items shared with you, enhancing teamwork and visibility across all your important information.

title: Go Global: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Noeko now offers robust support for numerous international languages, allowing users worldwide to engage seamlessly in their native tongue.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We're empowering our community by making Noeko open source, offering ultimate control, transparency, and a direct path to shape its exciting future.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge with Enhanced Graph View
summary: Gain deeper insights and jumpstart your workflows with an enhanced knowledge graph, featuring powerful new filters for tags, time, and shared items.

title: Personalized Search Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize information within your knowledge base by leveraging powerful new search filters and saving customized views for instant access.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: We're introducing dynamic content previews that seamlessly integrate linked information directly into your notes, fostering a more intuitive and interactive workspace.

title: Empower Your Workflow: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Access
summary: Get ready to host Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from new flexible premium plans designed to elevate your team's capabilities.

title: Revitalized and Expanded Theme Gallery
summary: Prepare to personalize your experience with a refreshed collection of enhanced themes and an exciting array of brand-new visual styles designed for every preference.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed welcome message on your homepage that genuinely matches the current time of day for a truly personalized experience.

title: Effortless Tag Cleanup
summary: Effortlessly remove items from a tag directly from the tag's overview, dramatically simplifying your content organization and saving valuable time.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: We are significantly expanding the types of content you can effortlessly bring into your workspace, including web pages, videos, and text files, to create a truly comprehensive knowledge hub.
